questions.question: The source says Nasyri was the only Kazan Muslim capable of productive work in the new schools, and that no Tatar scientific or popular scientific literature existed before him. Should these sweeping historical claims be qualified or documented? They are retained.

reconciliation.text: Complete English adaptation, read and proofread against the complete canonical Russian article and its figure records.
